source_name: Internet Archive / Digital Library of India
collection_name: Digital Library of India (DLI) — Telugu books
organization: Digital Library of India (IISc / MCIT, 2000s); re-hosted by Public Resource / Internet Archive
description: Telugu books scanned under the Digital Library of India / Million Books project, re-uploaded to IA (identifiers in.ernet.dli.2015.*, dli.ministry.*, dli.language.*). Covers classical kavyas, prabandhams, satakas, grammar, history, modern novels and translations.
genres: classical poetry; prose; history; grammar; novels; biographies; translations
size_telugu: 18,221 items; ~1.07 TB for a 5,000-item sample (est. ~3.9 TB total)
metadata_fields: title (often romanised); creator; year; publisher (sparse); barcode
ocr_transcription: IA Tesseract OCR; DLI metadata often has transliteration errors.
acquisition_method: ia search 'collection:digitallibraryindia AND language:(Telugu OR tel)' --itemlist; ia download ... --glob='*.pdf'
license: No licence on 4,975 of 5,000 sampled items; 25 CC BY-NC 4.0
copyright_notes: DLI scanned many in-copyright books (e.g. 1957 translation sampled). Screen by author death date (India life+60).
provenance: Original DLI portals (dli.iiit.ac.in, dli.ernet.in) are offline; IA is the surviving mirror. A 2014 Wikimedia grant page cites 23,322 Telugu DLI books with 4,476,970 pages in the original DLI.
verification_method: IA API counts, licence distribution and size from 5,000-item sample; item metadata inspected
unresolved_issues: ~5,000 Telugu DLI books from the original DLI may not be on IA (23,322 vs 18,221).
processing_needs: Re-OCR; fix romanised metadata; copyright filtering; dedup with Universal Library.

source_name: Andhra Pradesh State Archives / Telugu Wikisource

license: Public domain (age); Commons file licence applies to scans
verification_method: Commons API (1 AP Archives kaifiyat PDF found); catalogue size from publisher listing
unresolved_issues: No complete online set located; high-value digitisation gap.
